mission.demonslayer.final_selection.summ: Wisteria blooms all year from the foot of Mt. Fujikasane to its slope, penning in the demons the Corps has captured. Above the wisteria, on the mountaintop, they wait. Survive seven days among them and you will be a Demon Slayer.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.brie: Go to the shrine on Mt. Fujikasane and tell the Ubuyashiki twins you have come for the Final Selection. Rest on the bedroll they give you until nightfall.
At nightfall, climb through the last torii onto the mountaintop and survive seven nights there. Only nights you live through count; leaving the summit for 30 seconds ends the selection.
Optional: on the seventh night the Hand Demon emerges. Slay it for a greater reward.
Dying on the mountaintop ends the selection. You may take it again.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.refu: Demons cannot take the Final Selection.
You are already a member of the Demon Slayer Corps.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.begi: Survive seven nights on the mountaintop
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.tanj: That demon... I can smell it. It's eaten so many people, and it wants you next. Let me fight beside you!
Right! I'll take its arms. Go for the neck!
...Understood. I'll keep the others off you. Don't die!
We did it... Rest now, all of you he took.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.nigh: Night %s of %s. The demons are hungry.
Night %s of %s. Something enormous stirs on the mountain.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.dawn: Dawn breaks. Day %s. The demons hide from the light.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.leav: You have left the mountaintop! Go back up or the selection ends.
You are back on the mountaintop.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.fail: You left the mountaintop. The Final Selection is over for you, for now.
A demon cannot pass the Final Selection.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.hand: It has devoured over fifty candidates
Dawn breaks. The Hand Demon shrieks and drags itself into the earth of the mountain.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.pass: +%s kill record toward your next rank
Passive unlocked: Unyielding (the first lethal hit each day leaves you at 1 HP)
Your Nichirin blade will be forged from the ore you chose. A swordsmith will bring it in about %s days.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.nigh: The night was cut short. It doesn't count toward your seven.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.foot: This night won't count. Next dawn in %s
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.refu: The Final Selection is held at the shrine on Mt. Fujikasane. Speak with the Ubuyashiki twins there.
There is no Mt. Fujikasane in this world. An operator can raise one with /demonslayer fujikasane place.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.acce: Wait at the shrine with the other candidates until nightfall
The selection begins at nightfall. Stay near the shrine.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.migr: The Final Selection is now held from the shrine on Mt. Fujikasane. Go there and wait for nightfall.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.brie: The Ubuyashiki twins address the candidates
The twins are waiting for you at the shrine.
Good evening, everyone. Thank you for coming to the Final Selection.
On this mountain live demons that the Demon Slayers caught alive and imprisoned here.
Wisteria, which demons hate, blooms all year from the foot of the mountain to its slope. They cannot come down past it.
But from here on up, there is no wisteria. The mountaintop belongs to the demons.
Survive on the mountaintop for seven days. That is the condition for passing the Final Selection.
Now, please go. We will be waiting for you here.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.begi: Climb the north stairs through the torii onto the mountaintop.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.ente: You pass beneath the torii. There is no wisteria up here.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.fail: You never climbed onto the mountaintop. The Final Selection is over for you, for now.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.surv: You survived. Go down to the shrine
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.retu: Welcome back. Congratulations on coming home safely.
Please come here when you are ready.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.hand: Another little brat from Urokodaki? ...No? Shame. Hehe. What year is it now? Never mind. Forty-seven years I've been in this cage, and fifty of you whelps in my belly. You'll be the next.
Tanjiro's blade finds the Hand Demon's neck. It crumbles to ash.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.tanj: You did it... Rest now, all of you it took.
It's over. May they all rest now.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.pass: A Kasugai crow has been assigned to you. It will bring your orders.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.blad: A swordsmith from the village has found you and handed over your Nichirin blade, forged from the ore you chose.
Reach the shrine on Mt. Fujikasane
Wait for nightfall at the shrine
Return to the shrine and speak with the twins
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.foot: Night is falling. Stay at the shrine.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.twin: ...You are a demon. You have no place here. Leave this shrine.
Leave
Welcome to Mount Fujikasane. Have you come to take the Final Selection?
You came back. We are glad to see you alive. Will you try the Final Selection again?
I have come to take the Final Selection.
What is the Final Selection?
Tell me about this mountain.
Tell me the rules again.
I wish to withdraw.
Not yet.
I see.
Understood.
Farewell.
I'll go back up.
The Final Selection is the trial every swordsman of the Demon Slayer Corps has passed. When night falls, the candidates climb to the mountaintop.
Up there, demons hunt you. Survive seven days and you will join the Corps. Leave the mountaintop, and the selection is over.
The Demon Slayers bring demons they capture alive to this mountain. The wisteria keeps them from ever leaving.
Some of them have been here a very long time, and grown strong eating the candidates who did not come back.
Very well. The selection begins at nightfall. Take this bedroll and rest here until the sun sets; keep it with you on the mountain.
The selection begins at nightfall. Rest on your bedroll until then, here with the other candidates.
Please listen carefully.
The seven days are not over. You must return to the mountaintop.
If you withdraw now, you will not pass. You may try again another time. Do you still wish to withdraw?
Yes. I withdraw.
No, I'll stay.
We understand. Please take care of yourself.
You already carry orders of your own. Please see them through.
Your crow will bring your orders. We wish you good fortune, swordsman.
Your Nichirin blade is being forged. The swordsmith will find you when it is ready.
Welcome back. Of all who climbed the mountain, %s of you have come down again. We are very glad you returned safely.
First, we will take your measurements for your uniform. It is made of a special fabric that breathes, repels water and resists the claws of lesser demons.
Next, your rank. There are ten ranks in the Corps. You begin at the lowest: Mizunoto. It is engraved into the back of your hand, and will appear when you clench your fist and say your rank.
Now, please choose the ore that will be forged into your Nichirin blade. Look at each one closely; the steel you choose will cut demons in your stead.
A heavy, black lump that drinks the light
A pale ore that rings when you tap it
A rough stone veined with red
A small, dense nugget, cold to the touch
A smooth ore that feels warm in your palm
The swordsmith will forge your blade from it. It will be delivered to you in two days.
And lastly, this is your Kasugai crow. It will carry your orders and keep watch over you.
Thank you.
From this day, you are a swordsman of the Demon Slayer Corps. Please, take care.

npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.before: I'm Tanjiro Kamado! I trained with Mr. Urokodaki on Mt. Sagiri. Let's both make it through these seven days!
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.before.wh: A demon killed my family... and my little sister was turned into one. I'm going to become a Demon Slayer and find a way to make her human again.
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.trial: Stay sharp. I can smell more of them coming, and they're hungry.
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.after: We made it! I'm so glad you're all right!
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.bark.0: The wisteria smells so strong here... and above it, the demons.
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.bark.1: Mr. Urokodaki, I'll make it back. I promise.
npc.demonslayer.tanjiro_kamado.bark.2: Everyone, let's all come back down alive!
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.before: I'm going to die. I'm going to die here. Seven days?! With DEMONS?! ...If I die, tell Grandpa I really tried, okay?
Because Grandpa signed me up! I don't even want to be a swordsman! I just want to get married and live a quiet life!
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.trial: Why are there so MANY of them?! I want to go home!
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.after: I survived...? I actually survived? ...Wait, you mean there's MORE after this?
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.bark.0: Can't we do this in the daytime? Just once?
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.bark.1: Everyone here looks so strong... I'm doomed.
npc.demonslayer.zenitsu_agatsuma.bark.2: My heart's pounding so hard the demons can probably hear it.
npc.demonslayer.inosuke_hashibira.before: Hah! You smell weak! I'll be first to the top of that mountain, so stay out of my way!
To fight the strongest things there are! Then I'll be the strongest! Isn't that obvious?!
npc.demonslayer.inosuke_hashibira.trial: Pig Assault! Hahaha! These demons are nothing!
npc.demonslayer.inosuke_hashibira.after: Where's my sword?! I want my sword NOW!
npc.demonslayer.inosuke_hashibira.bark.0: Why are we waiting?! Just let me go up there already!
npc.demonslayer.inosuke_hashibira.bark.2: Hmph. This mountain's got nothing on mine.
npc.demonslayer.kanao_tsuyuri.before: (She smiles at you, but says nothing.)
npc.demonslayer.kanao_tsuyuri.before.why: (She takes out a coin, flips it, glances at it... and only smiles again.)
npc.demonslayer.kanao_tsuyuri.trial: (She keeps her eyes on the treeline, blade ready.)
npc.demonslayer.kanao_tsuyuri.after: (She gives you a small nod. Somewhere in her sleeve, a coin glints.)
npc.demonslayer.kanao_tsuyuri.bark.1: (She flips a coin and catches it.)
npc.demonslayer.genya_shinazugawa.before: What're you looking at? Back off. I'm not here to make friends.
I have to become a Hashira. There's someone I have to apologise to. That's all you need to know.
npc.demonslayer.genya_shinazugawa.trial: Tch. Don't get in my way.
npc.demonslayer.genya_shinazugawa.after: Just give me my blade already. I don't have time to wait.
npc.demonslayer.genya_shinazugawa.bark.0: Tch. How long are they going to make us stand here?
Use to read. While held, points the way to Mt. Fujikasane.
Your teacher has given you a letter of introduction to the Ubuyashiki household. Read it to learn the way to Mt. Fujikasane.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.title: To the Ubuyashiki Household
letter.demonslayer.introduction.1: I write on behalf of the student who carries this letter.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.2: They have trained under me until their body and their resolve were as hard as stone. I believe they are ready.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.3: I ask that they be permitted to take the Final Selection on Mount Fujikasane, where the wisteria blooms all year.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.4: Go to the shrine on the mountain's south face and speak with the Ubuyashiki children. The selection begins at nightfall. Come back alive.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.way: P.S. Mt. Fujikasane lies %s of here, about %s blocks away.
letter.demonslayer.introduction.way_unkn: P.S. Ask again once you know where Mt. Fujikasane lies.
mission.demonslayer.refuse.giver: This mission is given in person. Find the one who gives it.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.acce: The twins hand you a bedroll. Use it by day to rest until nightfall.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.hand: Hehe... Hard, isn't it? My neck. Blades break on it. That fox-masked boy's broke too.
Urokodaki! Urokodaki! Even now your brats keep coming up my mountain!
No... no, no! I don't want to die! I don't want to go!
Gaaah! My arm! You'll pay for that!
...Big brother... it's dark... Hold my hand...
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.tanj: (Tanjiro takes the crumbling hand gently.) May you be reborn somewhere kind.
Hunt the horned demon near the ruined hut
Find the lost sword near the pit in the north-west
Return the sword to its owner
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.ques: Help! Somebody, please! There are too many!
A scream from the dark! %s is cornered by demons, %s, %s blocks away.
You came... Thank you. I thought that was the end of me.
You drove the demons off %s. They press two rice balls into your hands.
You were too late for %s.
Inosuke, how about a contest?
A CONTEST?! Ha! Twelve demons before the sun comes up! If you can't do it, you're my underling forever!
You're on.
Inosuke's challenge: kill %s demons before dawn.
CHALLENGE WON
Inosuke grudgingly admits you're not weak
WHAT?! Already?! ...Fine! You're not bad! But next time I'm winning!
Dawn: %s of %s demons. Inosuke wins this one.
HAHAHA! I win! From today you're my underling!
Zenitsu, are you all right?
No! I'm NOT all right! They're everywhere around here, I can hear their hearts! Please, please get rid of them so I can breathe!
I'll clear them out.
You'll be fine.
Really?! You're a saint! I'll stay right here! Very quietly! Not moving at all!
Clear %s demons from around Zenitsu's hiding place.
The trees around Zenitsu are quiet. He shares the rice balls he was saving.
It's quiet... You really did it! Here, take my rice balls... I was saving them for my last meal.
Tanjiro, you look troubled.
There's a smell coming from near that ruined hut... a demon that has eaten far more people than the others. It's hunting anyone who goes near. Will you help me stop it?
Let's stop it.
Not now.
Hunt the horned demon near the ruined hut on the summit (it comes out at night).
Horned Demon
THE HORNED DEMON
It has eaten more than the others
HORNED DEMON SLAIN
Fewer candidates will be taken tonight
Thank you. I can't smell it anymore. The others will be a little safer now.
What's the coin for?
(She flips the coin. Heads. She smiles, and hands you a rice ball.)
(She flips the coin. Tails. She smiles, and says nothing.)
My sword... I dropped it running from the demons, near that pit in the north-west where the bones are. Without it I won't last another night.
I'll find it.
Stay hidden.
Truly? Thank you... Be careful. Something terrible lives near that pit.
Find the lost sword near the pit on the north-west of the summit.
Did you find it? Please, I can't fight without it.
Here's your sword.
You returned the sword. They share their rations and a bundle of wisteria incense.
My sword! Thank you, thank you. Take these. The incense keeps demons back for a little while.
Candidate's Sword
npc.demonslayer.candidate.before.0: I trained for two years for this... My hands won't stop shaking.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.before.1: My village was attacked last winter. I'm not going home until I can protect it.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.before.2: Seven nights. Just seven nights. ...Do you think anyone survives?
npc.demonslayer.candidate.trial.0: Stay sharp. I heard something in the trees.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.trial.1: How many nights is it now? I've lost count...
npc.demonslayer.candidate.trial.2: Keep moving. They find you if you stay still.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.after.0: We made it... I can't believe we made it.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.after.1: So few of us came back. We'll carry the rest with us.
npc.demonslayer.candidate.after.2: Mizunoto. The lowest rank. And yet I've never been prouder.
npc.demonslayer.captive_demon.mutter.0: Human... human flesh... it's been so long...
npc.demonslayer.captive_demon.mutter.1: Wisteria everywhere... but not up here. Not up here.
npc.demonslayer.captive_demon.mutter.5: They threw me in here... I'll eat every one of you!
npc.demonslayer.captive_demon.mutter.6: Don't run, don't run, don't run...
npc.demonslayer.captive_demon.mutter.7: Heh... that one over there died screaming too.

item.demonslayer.bedroll.tooltip: Use by day to rest until nightfall.
item.demonslayer.wisteria_incense.toolti: Light it: for 30 seconds lesser demons can't bear to come near.
rest.demonslayer.refuse.night: Night has fallen. There is no resting now.
rest.demonslayer.refuse.monsters: Not with something prowling this close.
rest.demonslayer.refuse.hurt: You're still catching your breath from a fight.
rest.demonslayer.resting: You unroll the bedroll and close your eyes... (sneak to get up)
rest.demonslayer.waiting: Resting... %s of %s needed are lying down. (sneak to get up)
rest.demonslayer.woke: You wake as the sun sinks behind the mountain.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.ques: Dawn broke and the horned demon burned in the sun before you could slay it.
rest.demonslayer.got_up: You roll the bedroll back up.
rest.demonslayer.refuse.ground: Find solid ground to lie on first.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.ling: You've stayed in one place too long. The demons have caught your scent and are closing in.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.hide: You are cowering at the edge of the wisteria. The selection asks you to survive among the demons, not to hide from them.
You hid by the wisteria instead of facing the mountain
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.tanj: That smell... down in the ravine. Something has been eating for a long time. Stay away from there.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.retu: Oi! You! Where's my blade?! I passed, didn't I? Hand it over!
...We will give you your uniform and your rank first. The blade is forged from the ore you choose.
Hey! Let go of her! You don't grab a girl's hair like that!
...If you are finished, we will continue.
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.twin: Before anything else: the bedroll we lent you belongs to the Corps. Please return it.
Hand back the bedroll
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.crow: CAW! CAW! I am your Kasugai crow! I will carry your orders! CAW! Do not die on your first mission!
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.smit: There you are! Your blade is ready. Don't you dare chip it!
Here. Nichirin steel changes colour for its wielder. Draw it and let's see... Take care of it, or I'll take care of you!
mission.demonslayer.final_selection.ques: Somebody! Anybody! Over here!
I can't hold them off! HELP!
Please... there are too many of them!
%s! That's %s for me! Keep up, slowpoke!
MORE... MORE FLESH... YOU WILL MAKE FIFTY!
npc.demonslayer.swordsmith.talk: Don't stand there gawking. A blade is a slayer's life. Keep it clean, keep it sharp, and keep it away from rocks!
npc.demonslayer.swordsmith.title: Swordsmith Village
